tesamorelin-approval-answer.summary: Tesamorelin: “Is it an approved medicine?” now answers for each country, with the US approval and Canada’s.
tesamorelin-approval-answer.detail: Before, the answer started with the EU status and did not name the US, where tesamorelin has been an approved medicine since 10 November 2010. It also left out Canada. It now answers for each country: approved in the US; approved in Canada on 29 April 2014, but the company stopped selling it there on 30 September 2022; not approved in the UK or Australia. The dates come from the FDA and Health Canada and are shown, with their sources, in the status table on the page.
